description: We are Team 5D!  We aim to win by turning complex NASA data into stunning visual catalogs and interactive maps. Our strengths: UI/UX design, professional PDFs, killer presentations, and basic Python. Why join us? We know how to pitch! We make ideas look brilliant to judges. We are looking for: Strong programmers (Web/Python) or Earth/Space data researchers. You handle the heavy data/coding; we handle the design and presentation to make our project a guaranteed winner. Let's win this!
